exposure: WHO 1999 criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus
WHO GDM criteria (non-GDM by both criteria, GDM by WHO 1999 only, GDM by WHO 2013 only, GDM by both criteria)
WHO 2013 criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus
WHO 2013 criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
outcome: Likelihood ratios for adverse pregnancy outcomes
cohort: 3338 women who underwent a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test at a single center in the Netherlands
finding: Applying the WHO 2013 criteria resulted in a 13.1% increase in GDM diagnoses compared to the WHO 1999 criteria, with newly diagnosed women showing an increased risk for adverse pregnancy outcomes, although lower than those identified by the WHO 1999 criteria.
